name: Kanojo ga Aitsu de, Ore wa Dare!?
original_name: 彼女がアイツで、俺はだれ!?
source:
I (Kazuharu Shimozono) am an ordinary boy student with no special abilities.

One day, I was called to the student council room by the school broadcast.

Waiting there was Oria Kirishima, the student council president, and as soon as she and I were alone with each other, the student council president said, "I was Nobunaga in my previous life! I will attack you!"

I didn't know what was happening, but I knew I was in danger, and I ran out of the room. Then an outright gyaru, Karan Yuki, appears, holding my hand and saying, "Are you okay?". She took me to the rooftop. With her hands on my face, she looked into my eyes and said, "It looks like we finally met...?" and she began to take off her clothes.

Apparently, they have memories of the past life... but I have no idea what it means.
And, I think it's normal, but I have no memories of my childhood, let alone my previous life.
translation:
我叫下园和治，是个再普通不过的男学生，没有任何特殊能力。

一天，学校广播叫我去学生会室。等在里面的是学生会长雾岛织爱。刚剩下我们两个，学生会长便说：“我前世就是信长！我要向你进攻！”

我虽然搞不清是什么情况，却知道大事不妙，拔腿冲出了房间。这时，一个打扮十足是辣妹的女生结城华兰出现在我面前，牵住我的手问：“你还好吧？”她带我上了天台，双手捧着我的脸，盯着我的眼睛说：“看来，我们终于见面了…？”然后便开始脱衣服。

她们似乎都记得自己的前世…可我根本不明白这意味着什么。而我虽然一直觉得这很平常，别说前世，就连小时候的事，我也一点都不记得。
